title: AMD action: getreminderappts
description: List appointment-reminder rows for a date range (optionally one patient_id). Returns start_date, end_date, count, by_remindertype, by_provider, by_provider_id, and an appts list. appts rows: appointment_id, appointment_datetime, remindertype, provider_id, provider_name, patient_id, patient_name, phone_cell. remindertype and appointment_datetime give the visit type and start time even when the schedule-grid sibling reports them blank.
